name: Börgerende-Rethwisch (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Börgerende-Rethwisch (crossed red tools on white above a white fish on blue).
history: Arms and flag were approved together by the Ministry of the Interior on 9 August 2000 and registered as no. 223 in the roll of arms of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

features.role: Börgerende-Rethwisch arms — crossed tools and fish
